input: Create a custom rubber stamp for my small business packaging

gold.taskTitle: Design a Custom Rubber Stamp for Packaging
gold.taskDescription: Create a custom rubber stamp to use on small business packaging materials.

questions.title: What text or business name goes on the stamp?
questions.description: Identify the exact wording, business name, tagline, or any specific text the stamp must display.

questions.title: Does the stamp need a logo or graphic element?
questions.description: Determine whether the stamp design includes any imagery, logo, icon, or is text-only.

questions.title: What size should the finished stamp be?
questions.description: Clarify the physical dimensions needed to fit the packaging surface.

questions.title: What type of packaging will the stamp be used on?
questions.description: Identify the surface being stamped, such as kraft boxes, tissue paper, mailer bags, or cardboard.

questions.title: What ink color do you want the stamp to print in?
questions.description: Determine the preferred ink color or colors to match the brand aesthetic.

questions.title: Will you design the artwork yourself or need help?
questions.description: Establish whether the user has a ready-made design file or needs to create or commission one first.

questions.title: What is your budget and timeline for this stamp?
questions.description: Understand spending limits and any deadline that affects which supplier or service to choose.
